violations.description: Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. -Bottom of make table found with temps of 47-50F. *Staff voluntarily disposed of sliced mushrooms and olives. Directed to move sliced cheese and condiments to different unit until unit is consistently holding temperatures below 41F.

Reheating food. — --Potentially hazardous food was not reheated rapidly so all parts reached a temperature of 165F for 15 seconds within one hour. -Roast cooked and cooled yesterday was shredded and reheated in crock pot today. Found at 135-174 at ~1:15 pm. Directed staff to move to cook top to finish reheat so that all parts reach 165F within next 15 minutes. *Crock pots are not appropriate for reheat of foods.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Residue in bottom interior of prep table drawer. -Frost build up at side and edge surfaces of burger/meat chest freezer.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Multiple cases of single use items stored on floor in basement.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Debris build up behind/below cook line equipment. -Dust/debris at wall above hood vents.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. -Employee food items stored in bottom of make table commingling with food service items. -Employee personal items (purses/etc.) stored commingling with food service item at counter top. *Employee items should be stored below and/or separate from food service items in a designated location.
